markImageColourClaimed.markImageColourClaimedText: The color(s) orange, blue, green, and white is/are claimed as a feature of the mark.

markImageDescriptions.markImageDescription: The mark consists of the design of two smaller circles overlapping a large circle; the larger central circle is blue with two white concentric rings inside of it; the two smaller circles appear on the right and left side of the larger circle; the circle on the left side is orange and smaller than the circle on the right side which is green. The entire mark appears on a white background.
